# Build handover

Read the [standard](../../../docs/standards/delivery.md) and
[template](../../../docs/templates/handover.md).
Summarise the player/contributor outcome, scope exclusions, current candidate,
spec/evidence versions, checks and limitations. Keep Small handovers concise.

List unresolved questions, decisions, findings and required Unverified evidence.
Link release/rollback arrangements or state Unknown. Request explicit G4 from the
product owner; it never substitutes for G5.

Before G5, stop while blockers remain. Do not describe the change as releasable
or invoke any deployment procedure until the release conditions are satisfied.

Output: handover, G4 request and clear remaining release blockers.
